title: Former Assad officer sentenced to 60 years in US for torture
english: A former Syrian military official, Samir Ousman Alsheikh, has been sentenced to 60 years in a US prison for his role in torturing detainees at Adra Prison between 2005 and 2008. During his trial, victims provided harrowing testimony detailing brutal abuse, including beatings and being suspended in painful positions while held in isolation. The judge condemned his actions as exceptionally cruel, emphasizing that he utilized his authority to inflict violence on political dissenters without fear of accountability.

oromo: Hojjetaan mootummaa fi ajajaan waraanaa duraanii Siriyaa, Samir Ousman Alsheikh, gidduu bara 2005 hanga 2008tti mana hidhaa Adraa keessatti namoota irratti gidiraa fi dararaa cimaa raawwachuun isaa mirkanaa'ee waggaa 60 hidhuuf murtaa'eera. Murtii kana irratti ragaaleen dhiyaatan, shakkamaan kun namoota irratti reebicha hamaa fi dararaa qaamaa gara jabinaa qabu raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Abbaan murtii gocha isaa kana akka gocha hamaa fi aangoo isaa fayyadamee namoota irratti gidiraa cimaa geessiseetti ilaaluun murtii kana dabarsaniiru.

title: Tunisia floods disrupt capital as heavy rain traps motorists and residents
english: Heavy rainfall recently paralyzed Tunisia's capital, causing severe flooding that trapped commuters in their vehicles and triggered power and internet outages. Residents and local experts have expressed growing frustration, noting that the city's drainage systems frequently fail to handle seasonal rains. Despite advance weather warnings, critics argue that authorities have neglected essential infrastructure maintenance and flood prevention measures.

oromo: Roobni cimaan magaalaa guddittii Tunisiyaatti roobe daandiiwwan magaalaa guutuu bishaan guutuun cufuun, konkolaattotni karaatti akka hafan fi tajaajilli elektirikii fi interneetii akka addaan citu godheera. title: Iran expels Swedish diplomat in retaliatory move
english: Iran has ordered a Swedish diplomat to leave the country within two days in direct retaliation for Sweden’s decision to expel an Iranian official. Sweden justified its move by citing concerns over Iranian activities that threatened national security and specifically targeted Jewish and Israeli interests. In response, Iran condemned the Swedish action as unjustified, accusing Stockholm of being influenced by foreign pressure and failing to uphold diplomatic standards.

title: Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘big decision’ on Iran, tanker hit in Hormuz
english: President Donald Trump is considering a significant military decision regarding Iran, noting that any outcome is possible as tensions rise. Meanwhile, Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported attacking a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz, claiming the vessel was operating illegally. These events highlight a growing instability in the region as both nations remain at a critical standoff.

title: Migrant sea crossings to Europe drop sharply as deaths rise: IOM
english: The International Organization for Migration reports that the number of migrants attempting to reach Europe by sea has fallen significantly this year. However, despite fewer people making the journey, the number of deaths and disappearances has increased, making these maritime routes deadlier than before. Officials emphasize that most migrants are fleeing war, persecution, and economic hardship, and they are calling for stronger international action to provide safer migration pathways.

title: US approves $414M uranium investment in Niger, two years after troops left
english: The United States government has authorized $414 million in financing for a major uranium mining project in Niger operated by the Canadian firm Global Atomic. This significant investment aims to secure American access to critical mineral supplies while strengthening diplomatic ties following the withdrawal of U.S. troops from the region. Despite ongoing political instability and security concerns in Niger, the project is viewed as a strategic move to counter the influence of rival global powers in the energy sector.

title: Russia election: Could other parties challenge United Russia?
english: Russia is holding its first elections since the onset of the conflict in Ukraine in 2022. The governing party, United Russia, has maintained its hold on power for more than twenty years with the support of President Vladimir Putin. Voters are now considering whether any of the opposing political parties can effectively contest the ruling party's long-standing dominance.

title: Trinidad and Tobago ends state of emergency amid pushback over mass arrests
english: Trinidad and Tobago has officially ended its state of emergency, which previously allowed authorities to detain citizens without filing formal charges. This decision follows significant public and legal backlash regarding mass arrests and alleged human rights violations during the crackdown on crime. Moving forward, the government intends to develop permanent legislation focused on fighting gangs and violent crime while incorporating better judicial oversight.

oromo: Trinidad fi Tobago labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa, kan aangoo mootummaa namoota utuu himannaan irratti hin dhiyaatin hidhuu dandeessisu akka haqe ibsameera. Murtoon kun kan dhume, hidhaa baay'inaa fi caba mirga namoomaa ilaalchisee mormii guddaan erga ka'ee booda. Mootummaan labsii kana bakka buusuuf, yakka fi garee badii to'achuuf gargaaruu fi kanneen seeraa fi mirga lammiilee kabajanii fi hordoffii mana murtiitiin hogganamu seera dhaabbata ta'e baasuuf karoorfateera.

title: US judge orders 30-day notice prior to any Kennedy Center physical changes
english: A federal judge has mandated that the Kennedy Center must provide a 30-day notice before undertaking any significant structural modifications or demolition. This ruling follows concerns regarding the facility's safety and President Trump's recent comments suggesting the building might need to be torn down. The center is currently closed for repairs due to identified structural risks, sparking a legal disagreement over its future.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ዳኛ የኬኔዲ ማእከል ማንኛውንም ትልቅ የአካል ለውጥ ወይም ህንጻ የማፍረስ ስራ ከመጀመሩ በፊት የ30 ቀናት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንዲሰጥ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ማእከሉ በደህንነት ስጋት ምክንያት ከተዘጋ በኋላ እና ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ህንጻው ሊፈርስ እንደሚችል የሰጡትን አስተያየት ተከትሎ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ህንጻው ባጋጠመው የመዋቅር ችግር ምክንያት ለጥገና ተዘግቷል፣ ይህም በወደፊት እጣ ፈንታው ላይ ህጋዊ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa kan Amerikaa, giddugalli Kennedy Center jijjiirama gurguddaa ykn diiggaa kamiyyuu gaggeessuu isaa dura guyyaa 30 dursanii beeksisuu akka qaban ajajaniiru. Ajajni kun kan dhufe erga giddugalli kun rakkoo nageenyaatiin sababeeffatee cufamee fi Prezidaantiin Donald Trump giddugalli kun diigamuu danda'a jechuun erga dubbatanii booda. Amma giddugalli kun rakkoo qulqullina ijaarsaa irraa kan ka'e haaromsaaf cufamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis mata duree wal-dhabdee seeraa ta'ee jira.

title: Trump administration approves sale of F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
english: The Trump administration has requested congressional approval for a $24.3 billion deal to sell 48 advanced F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia. Officials state this sale aims to strengthen a key regional ally without disrupting the existing military balance, even as Saudi forces face increased pressure from Houthi fighters in Yemen. However, the proposal faces scrutiny due to concerns regarding potential Chinese intelligence access to the technology and the ongoing intensity of the Yemeni conflict.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር 48 ዘመናዊ የኤፍ-35 ተዋጊ ጄቶችን ለሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በ24.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለመሸጥ ከኮንግረስ ፈቃድ ጠይቋል። መንግሥት ይህ ስምምነት የቀጠናውን ወታደራዊ ሚዛን ሳይቀይር ጠቃሚ አጋርን ለማጠናከር ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ በየመን ግጭት መባባስ እና የቻይና የስለላ ድርጅቶች ይህንን የጦር ቴክኖሎጂ የመቆጣጠር አቅም ይኖራቸዋል በሚል ስጋት የበርካታ ወገኖችን ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Trump xiyyaarota waraanaa gosa F-35 ta'an 48 biyya Saudi Arabiaaf doolaara biliyoona 24.3n gurguruuf hayyama Kongiresii gaafateera. Mootummaan US akka jedhutti, gurgurtaan kun walmadaallii waraanaa naannichaa osoo hin jijjiirin michummaa biyyoota lamaan cimsuuf kan gargaaru dha. Ta'us, gurgurtaan kun waraana Yemen keessatti hammaataa jiruun akkasumas soda teknolojii waraanaa kana irratti humni Chaayinaa harka galfachuu danda'a jedhuun mormii fi yaaddoo keessa seeneera.

title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
english: The United States has issued visas to a group of Iranian officials, including President Masoud Pezeshkian, to attend the upcoming UN General Assembly in New York. While these officials are permitted to participate in the diplomatic meetings, the US government has imposed strict travel and purchasing limitations on the delegation. These restrictions aim to prevent the group from engaging in luxury shopping while emphasizing that the move is necessary to fulfill international host obligations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራኑን ፕሬዝዳንት መስዑድ መድሃኒያንን ጨምሮ ለኢራን ልዑካን በኒውዮርክ በሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንዲሳተፉ ቪዛ ሰጥቷል። ልዑካኑ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስብሰባዎች ላይ እንዲሳተፉ ቢፈቀድላቸውም፣ አሜሪካ በጉዞአቸው እና በግዢያቸው ላይ ጥብቅ ገደቦችን ጥላለች። እነዚህ ገደቦች ልዑካኑ የቅንጦት ዕቃዎችን እንዳይገዙ ለመከላከል ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ውሳኔውም የተባበሩት መንግስታትን የመስተንግዶ ግዴታዎች ለመወጣት ታሳቢ ተደርጎ የተወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Iraan Masuud Pezeshkian dabalatee garee bakka buutota Iraanif sagantaa walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Nyuuyorkitti gaggeeffamu irratti hirmaachuuf hayyama seeninsaa (visa) kenneera. Bakka buutonni kun walga'iiwwan diippiloomaasii irratti akka hirmaatan kan hayyamameef ta'us, Ameerikaan imala fi bituu meeshaalee irratti daangaa cimaa keesseerti. Daangaan kun gareen kun meeshaalee gita ol aanaa akka hin bitne kan taasisu yoo ta'u, murtoon kunis dirqama biyya hostii ta'uun ishee bahuuf kan fudhatame dha.

title: Yemenis recount journey to Djibouti as refugee arrivals surge
english: A growing number of refugees are fleeing the ongoing conflict in Yemen and arriving in Djibouti seeking safety. In response to this surge, the Djiboutian government has requested urgent international aid to support these displaced individuals. Local authorities are struggling to manage the influx and are calling for global assistance to provide necessary humanitarian relief.
amharic: በየመን እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት በመሸሽ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ወደ ጅቡቲ እየገቡ ይገኛሉ። የጅቡቲ መንግስት ለስደተኞቹ ሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ከአለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እርዳታ ጠይቋል። አገሪቱ ከስደተኞች መጨመር ጋር ተያይዞ የሚያጋጥማትን ጫና ለመቋቋም የአለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልጋት አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman waraana Yemen keessatti geggeeffamaa jiru irraa baqachuun nagaa barbaacha gara Jibuutii imalaa jiru. Mootummaan Jibuutiis baqattoota kana gargaaruuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa gaafateera. Baqattoonni kun baay'achaa waan jiraniif, biyyattiin rakkoo kana ba'uuf deeggarsa hatattamaa barbaaddi.

title: US approves visas for top Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly
english: The United States has granted visas to key Iranian officials, including President Masoud Pezeshkian, to attend the upcoming UN General Assembly in New York. While the delegation is permitted to enter the country, they will face significant travel restrictions and limits on luxury purchases. This decision comes amidst ongoing military tensions between the two nations, even as other officials, such as those from the Palestinian Authority, have been denied entry.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራኑን ፕሬዝዳንት መስዑድ ፔዘሽኪያን ጨምሮ ለተወሰኑ ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በኒውዮርክ በሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንዲገኙ ቪዛ ፈቅዷል። ልዑኩ ወደ አሜሪካ እንዲገቡ ቢፈቀድላቸውም፣ ጥብቅ የጉዞ ገደቦች እና የቅንጦት ዕቃዎችን ከመግዛት ጋር የተያያዙ ክልከላዎች ተጥለውባቸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ውጥረት ባለበት ወቅት የተወሰደ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ላሉ ሌሎች አካላት ግን ቪዛ መከልከሉ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa pirezidaantii Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaanii dabalatee qondaaltonni olaanoo biyyattii gamaagama walii galaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii Niiwuu Yoorkitti gaggeeffamu irratti akka hirmaatan hayyama viizaa kenneera. Gareen kun biyyattii akka seenan hayyamameefis, daangaa imalaafi bitii meeshaalee jaalalaa irratti uggurri cimaan irratti taa'eera. Murtichi biyyoota lamaan gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi waraanaa utuu jiru kan fudhatame yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni biroo kanneen akka bulchiinsa Falasxiinii garuu viizaa akka hin arganne taasifameera.

title: Pennsylvania seeks CDC help amid dispute over US measles deaths
english: Pennsylvania is requesting federal assistance from the CDC to manage a worsening measles outbreak, which is the most severe in the U.S. since 1991. However, state officials are threatening to cancel this help unless the CDC officially acknowledges four deaths the state attributes to the virus. Federal health officials have criticized this stance, arguing that public health aid should not be used as a tool for political leverage.
amharic: ፔንስልቬንያ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የኩፍኝ ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር ከበሽታ መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከል (CDC) እርዳታ ጠይቃለች። ሆኖም የክልሉ ባለስልጣናት በቫይረሱ ምክንያት የሞቱ አራት ሰዎችን የሟቾች ዝርዝር ውስጥ ካልካተቱ የጠየቁትን እርዳታ እንደሚሰርዙ አስፈራርተዋል። የፌደራል ጤና ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት ይህን ድርጊት የህዝብ ጤና እርዳታን ለፖለቲካ መጠቀሚያ ለማድረግ መሞከር ነው በማለት ነቅፈውታል።
oromo: Pensilveeniyaan tatamsa'ina dhukkuba mannxaa to'achuuf gargaarsa CDC gaafatteetti, kunis walitti fufiinsa dhukkuba mannxaa bara 1991 as biyyattii keessatti mudate keessaa isa hamaadha. Haata'u malee, qondaaltonni naannichaa yoo CDC namoota dhukkubichaan du'an afur raasmiin beekamtii hin kennine gargaarsa gaafatame akka haqan doorsisaniiru. Qondaaltonni fayyaa federaalaa gochi kun gargaarsa fayyaa ummataa akka meeshaa siyaasaatti fayyadamuu akka ta'e ibsuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Russia, China veto UN mandate to monitor Iran sanctions
english: Russia and China have blocked a United Nations Security Council resolution that sought to extend the mandate for an independent panel to monitor sanctions against Iran. This move effectively eliminates the watchdog group responsible for investigating and reporting potential violations of nuclear and military restrictions. While eleven nations supported the extension, the opposition from the two permanent members leaves a significant gap in international oversight of Iran's activities.
amharic: ሩሲያ እና ቻይና በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን እና በኢራን ላይ የተጣሉ ማዕቀቦችን በገለልተኛ አካል እንዲከታተሉ የሚያስችለውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ውሳኔ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የኢራንን የኒውክሌር እና ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በመከታተል የህግ ጥሰቶችን የሚዘግብበትን ሂደት እንዲያበቃ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኛዎቹ የካውንስሉ አባላት የክትትል ስራው እንዲቀጥል ቢደግፉም፣ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ተቃውሞ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የሚደረገውን የክትትል ስራ አቋርጦታል።
oromo: Raashiyaan fi Chaayinaan murtoo Mana Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii kan irratti adabbiiwwan biyyoolessa Iraan irratti kaa'aman gamtaa walabaan hordofuu dandeessisu mormuun akka hin raggaane taasisaniiru. Murteen kun garee qorattootaa kan seera cabsuu Iraan irratti gabaasa dhiheessaa ture akka dhaabbatu godheera. Biyyoonni 11 murtoo kana deggeran iyyuu, mormiin biyyoota lamaanii kun hordoffii addunyaa irratti Iraan gochaa jirtu irratti taasifamu akka gufatu taasisera.

title: At least 26 killed in clashes along Sudan-South Sudan border region
english: Violent clashes between the Ngok Dinka and Misseriya communities in the disputed Abyei region have resulted in at least 26 deaths and 82 injuries. The fighting was triggered by separate killings earlier in the week at a local market, worsening long-standing tensions over land and resources. The UN peacekeeping force in the area has increased security measures and is currently working with community leaders to restore peace and prevent further violence.
amharic: በሱዳን እና በደቡብ ሱዳን ድንበር ላይ በሚገኘው አቢዬ ክልል በንግኦክ ዲንካ እና በሚሴሪያ ማህበረሰቦች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 82 የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ግጭቱ የተቀሰቀሰው በአካባቢው ገበያ ላይ በተፈጸሙ የግለሰብ ግድያዎች ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ይህንም ተከትሎ በሁለቱ ቡድኖች መካከል የነበረው የረጅም ጊዜ አለመግባባት ተባብሷል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል በአካባቢው ያለውን የፀጥታ ሁኔታ በማጠናከር ግጭቱን ለማብረድ ከማህበረሰብ መሪዎች ጋር እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Abyei kan daangaa Sudaan fi Sudaan Kibbaa gidduutti argamuutti walitti bu'iinsa uumamee tureen namoonni 26 ol ajjeefamanii 82 immoo madaa'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan ka'e gabaa naannichaa keessatti namoota ajjeefamanii booda yoo ta'u, kunis waldhabdee lafaa fi qabeenya irratti gosa lamaan gidduutti ture hammeesseera. Humnoonni nageenya kabachiiftotaa UN naannichatti ramadaman nageenya eeguuf tarkaanfii jabeessanii fi walitti bu'iinsi biroo akka hin uumamneef hoggantoota gosaa wajjin mari'achaa jiru.

title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
english: A UN investigative mission reported that US missile strikes on a primary school and a sports facility in Iran likely constitute war crimes due to the high civilian death toll. The experts also found that Iranian authorities engaged in crimes against humanity by using excessive and lethal force against protesters nationwide. Both the US and Iranian governments are being implicated in serious human rights violations as civilians suffer from the ongoing regional conflict.

oromo: Ogeeyyoonni gamtaa mootummootaa akka jedhanitti, haleellaan galaa Ameerikaan mana barumsaa fi iddoo ispoortii irratti Iran keessatti gaggeessite, lubbuu namoota nagaa hedduu waan galaafateef yakka waraanaa ta'uu danda'a. Dabalataanis, mootummaan Iran mormii biyyoolessaa irratti humna garmalee fayyadamuun yakka namummaa irratti raawwatamu qabu raawwateera jedhameera. Garaagarummaa biyyoota lamaanii kanaan namoonni nagaa miidhaa cimaa fi cabsuu mirga namoomaa keessa jiraachuu gabaasichi ifa godheera.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israelis protest outside ‘NAZA’ filmmaker’s home
english: A group of Israeli protesters recently gathered at the family home of a filmmaker to express their anger over a new movie called NAZA. The demonstrators chanted aggressive slogans, labeling the director a traitor for the film's content. Meanwhile, Palestinians in the West Bank continue to endure ongoing violence from both military operations and settler attacks.
amharic: ናዛ በተሰኘው ፊልም የተበሳጩ እስራኤላውያን በፊልሙ አዘጋጅ ቤተሰብ መኖሪያ ቤት ፊት ለፊት ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ፊልሙን በማዘጋጀታቸው አዘጋጁን ከዳተኛ በማለት ጮክ ብለው ተሳድበዋል። በሌላ በኩል በዌስት ባንክ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን ጥቃት መጋፈጣቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Namoonni Israa'el tokko tokko fiilmii 'NAZA' jedhamu kan qopheessaa irratti aaruun, mana maatii isaa duratti hiriira mormii godhaniiru. Namoonni kunneen qopheessicha gantuu jechuun arrabsaa fi mormii cimaa agarsiisaniiru. title: US secures release of detained citizen Adam Castillo in Myanmar
english: The United States government has successfully negotiated the release of American businessman Adam Castillo, who spent three months in a Myanmar prison. Castillo was arrested in June over allegations of financial misconduct and breach of trust related to his work with a local business organization. Following diplomatic discussions between US officials and the Myanmar government, he was freed and safely transported to Thailand.

oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa daldalaa lammii Ameerikaa kan ta'an Adam Kaastiloo, ji'a sadiif biyya Miyaanmaar keessatti hidhamanii turan mariin hiiksisuu danda'eera. Kaastiloo ji'a Waxabajjii keessa kan hidhaman, dhaabbata daldalaa tokko wajjin walqabatee himannaa yakka maallaqaa fi amanamummaa dhabuu irratti hundaa'uun ture. Qondaaltota Ameerikaa fi mootummaa Miyaanmaar gidduutti marii dipilomaasii erga taasifamee booda, namni kun gadhiifamanii gara biyya Taayilaandiitti geeffamaniiru.

title: South Africa gender commissioner: women ‘hunted’ amid femicide crisis
english: A series of violent killings has targeted women in South Africa's Ekurhuleni region, with a ninth victim recently discovered. Gender equality commissioner Princess Eurika Mogane described the situation as a war-like crisis where women are being actively hunted. These attacks have sparked urgent concerns regarding the safety of women in the country.

oromo: Naannoo Ekuuruleni kan Afrikaa Kibbaatti dubartoota irratti ajjeechaan raawwatamaa jiru daran hammaatee jiraachuu isaatiin, reeffi dubartii saglaffaa argameera. Komishinarri qixxee koorniyaa Princess Eurika Mogane haala kana akka waraanaatti kan ibsan yoo ta'u, dubartoonni akka bineensaatti adadamaa akka jiran himaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun nageenya dubartootaa biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: English FA calls for Infantino to release FIFA World Cup sell-off documents
english: Debbie Hewitt, chair of the English Football Association, has demanded that FIFA President Gianni Infantino disclose all documents regarding a failed plan to sell World Cup stakes to private investors. This request follows significant international criticism and a loss of confidence in Infantino's leadership, particularly from UEFA. Furthermore, Hewitt is seeking transparency regarding a controversial decision to lift a player's ban following political intervention.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ማህበር ሊቀመንበር ዴቢ ሂዊት፣ የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የነበረውን ውድቅ የሆነ ዕቅድ ዝርዝር መረጃዎች ይፋ እንዲያደርጉ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የተነሳው በዕቅዱ ላይ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ በመቀስቀሱ እና በኢንፋንቲኖ አመራር ላይ እምነት ማጣት በመፈጠሩ ነው። በተጨማሪም ሂዊት ከፖለቲካዊ ጣልቃገብነት ጋር በተያያዘ የተነሳውን የተጫዋች እገዳ የማንሳት ውሳኔ ግልጽ እንዲደረግ ትጠይቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Federeeshinii Kubbaa Miilaa Ingiliz Debbi Hiwiit, pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo karoora yeroo gabaabaa booda fashalaa'e kan waancaa addunyaa investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruu ilaalchisee sanadoota hunda ifa akka godhan gaafataniiru. Gaaffiin kun kan dhufe mormii guddaa addunyaa maraa fi UEFA dabalatee hoggansa Infaantiinoo irratti amantii dhabuu hordofuudha. Kana malees, Hiwiit dhimma dhorkaa taphataa tokkoo irratti giddu-galummaa siyaasaatiin walqabatee murtee fudhatame ilaalchisee ibsa gahaa akka kennamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Brazil’s Lula announces welfare increases ahead of presidential election
english: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has announced a 15 percent boost to the Bolsa Familia welfare program just weeks before the upcoming presidential election. The government stated that this increase aims to help low-income families cope with high inflation and maintain their purchasing power. While the move is intended to support citizens, it arrives during a tight race against challenger Flavio Bolsonaro.
amharic: የብራዚሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ በቅርቡ ለሚደረገው ምርጫ ጥቂት ሳምንታት ሲቀሩት የቦልሳ ፋሚሊያ የተሰኘው ማህበራዊ ድጋፍ ክፍያ በ15 በመቶ እንዲያድግ አድርገዋል። መንግስት እንዳለው ይህ የክፍያ ጭማሪ ድሃ ቤተሰቦች በዋጋ ግሽበት ምክንያት የገጠማቸውን የኑሮ ጫና ለመቋቋም እንዲችሉ ታስቦ የተደረገ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ተወዳዳሪው ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ እያደረጉት ባለው ጠንካራ የምርጫ ፉክክር ወቅት የተወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin biyya Brazil Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa da Silvaa filannoo dhufuuf jedhuuf torbanoota muraasa hafanitti, sagantaa gargaarsa hawaasaa 'Bolsa Familia' irratti daballii kaffaltii dhibbeentaa 15 godhaniiru. Mootummaan akka ibsetti, daballii kaffaltii kana kan godhe maatiiwwan harka qalleeyyii ta'an gatiin meeshaalee fi tajaajilaa dabaluun jireenya irratti dhiibbaa geessise akka dandamatan gargaaruufidha. Tarkaanfiin kun qophii filannoo cimaa morkataa isaanii Filaaviyoo Bolsoonaroo waliin taasisan keessatti kan fudhatamedha.

title: UN investigators find 'reasonable grounds' US committed war crimes in Iran
english: A UN investigation has concluded that there is credible evidence the United States committed war crimes during military strikes in Iran. The report highlights attacks on an elementary school and a sports facility, which caused significant civilian casualties, including the deaths of many children. While this finding is not a legal verdict, it has been officially presented to the UN Human Rights Council for further review.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ባደረገው ምርመራ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ በወሰደችው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የጦር ወንጀል እንደፈጸመች የሚያሳዩ በቂ ማስረጃዎች መኖራቸውን አስታውቋል። ሪፖርቱ አሜሪካ በአንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት እና በስፖርት ማዘውተሪያ ላይ የፈጸመችው ጥቃት በርካታ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ለብዙ ንጹሃን ዜጎች ህልፈት ምክንያት መሆኑን ጠቅሷል። ይህ ግኝት የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ባይሆንም፣ ጉዳዩ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ምክር ቤት ለቀጣይ ክትትል ቀርቧል።
oromo: Qorannoon tokko kan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin gaggeeffame, Ameerikaan Iran irratti haleellaa raawwatte keessatti yakka waraanaa raawwachuu ishee akka amanu ibseera. Gabaasichi haleellaa manneen barnootaa fi bakka ispoortii irratti raawwatame keessatti ijoollee hedduu dabalatee namoonni nagaa baay'een ajjeefamuu isaanii ibsa. Kun murtee seeraa ta'uu baatus, gabaasichi qorannoo dabalataaf gara Mana Maree Mirga Namoomaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti dabarfameera.

title: At least 63 killed in latest fighting between Yemen government, Houthis
english: A recent surge in violence between Yemen's government forces and Houthi rebels has resulted in at least 63 deaths within a single day. The casualties include 23 government soldiers lost to drone and missile strikes in the southwest, while 40 Houthi fighters were killed by Saudi-led airstrikes and ground combat. This intense fighting underscores the ongoing volatility of the conflict in the region.
amharic: በየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል በተቀሰቀሰ አዲስ ግጭት ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ ቢያንስ 63 ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተገለጸ። ከሟቾቹ መካከል 23ቱ በመንግስት በኩል የነበሩ ወታደሮች ሲሆኑ የተገደሉት በድሮን እና በሮኬት ጥቃት ነው። ቀሪዎቹ 40 የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ደግሞ በሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሚመራው ጥምረት ባደረገው የአየር ድብደባ እና በምድር ውጊያ ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Giddutti waraana mootummaa Yaman fi fincileeyyii Huutii gidduutti dhohe kanaan guyyaa tokko keessatti namoonni 63 du'anii jiru. Humni mootummaa lolaan kunis xiyyaara malee fi rokeetiin haleelamuun waraana 23 dhabeera. Gama biraatiin ammoo, haleellaa qilleensa irraa fi lola lafa irraatiin fincileeyyii Huutii 40 ta'an ajjeefamuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Trump says he is deciding whether to ‘annihilate’ Iran
english: Former President Donald Trump has stated he is contemplating whether to take aggressive military action against Iran. While he characterized the choice as a significant decision, he also noted that Iranian officials are currently seeking to establish a diplomatic agreement. He suggested that the situation remains fluid and that his final course of action is still uncertain.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ስለመውሰድ እያሰቡ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ውሳኔው ትልቅ እንደሆነ ቢናገሩም፣ በሌላ በኩል የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ጠቅሰዋል። ጉዳዩ አሁንም እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንዳለና የመጨረሻ ውሳኔያቸው እንዳልታወቀ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Donald Tiraamp, Iran irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuu fi dhiisuurratti yaadaa jiraachuu ibsaniiru. Murtii kana kan ibsan murtoo guddaa ta'uu isaa kan dubbatan yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin mootummaan Iran waliigaltee irra ga'uuf fedhii akka qabu eeraniiru. Haalli kun ammaaf kan hin murtoofne ta'uu fi tarkaanfiin gara fuulduraa isaanii maal akka ta'e ifa miti.

title: Exam Reforms Aren’t Fixing Ethiopia’s Institutional Decay
english: Despite significant efforts to tighten security during national exams, Ethiopia’s education system continues to face deep-seated ethical challenges. While reforms successfully reduced cheating, the alarmingly low pass rates revealed that many students struggle to demonstrate basic knowledge without dishonest shortcuts. The article argues that the 'hidden curriculum'—where students prioritize grades over integrity—is failing to foster the values of honesty and responsibility needed to strengthen the nation's institutions.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የብሔራዊ ፈተናዎችን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር ጥረት ብታደርግም፣ በትምህርት ሥርዓቱ ውስጥ ያሉ የሥነ-ምግባር ችግሮች አሁንም አሳሳቢ ሆነው ቀጥለዋል። የፈተና ማጭበርበርን ለመከላከል የተደረጉ ማሻሻያዎች ውጤታማ ቢሆኑም፣ የተማሪዎች ውጤት በእጅጉ ማሽቆልቆሉ ተማሪዎች ያለ ማጭበርበር እውቀታቸውን ማሳየት እንደተሳናቸው አሳይቷል። ችግሩ ትምህርት ቤቶች ስለ ታማኝነት ከማስተማር ይልቅ በውጤት ላይ ብቻ በማተኮር ተማሪዎችን እሴት በጎደለው መንገድ እየቀረፁ መሆናቸው እንደሆነ ይተነትናል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan qormaata biyyaalessaa irratti gowwomsaa fi seeraan alaa hambisuuf yaalii gootee jirtus, rakkoon amanamummaa fi hubannoo barnoota keessatti mul'atu bal'aa dha. Fooyya'iinsi qormaataa gowwomsaa xiqqeessus, baay'inni barattootaa qabxii darbiinsaa argachuu dadhabuun isaanii barnoota bu'uuraa irratti rakkoo cimaa akka jiru agarsiisa. Qophiin kun, mana barnootaa keessatti barattoonni akkaataa itti qabxii qofaaf dursa kennanii fi amanamummaa dagatan, dhaloota dhugaa fi itti gaafatamummaa hin qabne akka uumaa jiru ibsa.

title: Swedish PM Kristersson resigns after election loss
english: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has stepped down following a narrow defeat in the recent general election. His right-wing coalition lost to the center-left opposition led by Magdalena Andersson, who is now expected to begin forming a new government. The process of selecting a new leader will be overseen by the Speaker of the Parliament, though potential policy disagreements among the opposition parties may delay the formation of the new cabinet.
amharic: የስዊድን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኡልፍ ክሪስተርሰን በቅርቡ በተካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ በትንሽ ድምፅ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል። የክሪስተርሰን የቀኝ ዘመም ጥምረት በማግደሌና አንደርሰን ለሚመራው የግራ ዘመም ተቃዋሚዎች በመሸነፉ፣ አዲስ መንግስት የመመስረት ሂደቱ በቅርቡ ይጀምራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። የመንግስት ምስረታ ሂደቱ በፓርላማው አፈ-ጉባኤ የሚመራ ቢሆንም፣ በተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች መካከል ባለው የፖሊሲ ልዩነት ምክንያት አዲሱን መንግስት ለመመስረት ጊዜ ሊወስድ ይችላል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Siwiidin Ulf Kiristerson filannoo biyyoolessaa gaggeeffame irratti injifatamuun isaa hordofee aangoo gadhiiseera. Kutaaleen mirgaa inni hogganu kutaalee bitaa kan Maagdalenaa Andersooniin hogganaman duraan injifatamaniiru. Amma hooggantuun kun mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf karoorfataa jirti. Adeemsi filannoo dura bu'aa paarlamaan kan hogganamu ta'us, paartilee mormituu gidduutti garaagarummaan siyaasaa waan jiruuf, hundeeffama mootummaa haaraatiif yeroo dheeraa fudhachuu danda'a.

title: Ghalibaf’s maths missile at Trump decoded: Is Iran fixing US interest rates?
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf used a financial mathematical formula on social media to mock US efforts to influence the ongoing conflict through interest rate hikes. Ghalibaf suggested that raising interest rates is ineffective against Iran’s control of the Strait of Hormuz, which remains blocked to global shipping. His comments emphasize Tehran's belief that it holds significant power over the global economy and US financial policy during this wartime standoff.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የዋለ ወለድ ጭማሪ ፖሊሲ ላይ በማሾፍ ማህበራዊ ሚዲያን ተጠቅመዋል። የኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን መቆጣጠርና መዝጋት በአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ውሳኔዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚያሳድር በኢኮኖሚ ቀመር በማስረዳት አጣጥለዋል። ይህ መልእክት ቴህራን በጦርነቱ ወቅት በአሜሪካ የፋይናንስ ፖሊሲ ላይ ተጽዕኖ የመፍጠር አቅም እንዳላት ለማሳየት የተደረገ ሙከራ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraan Mohaammad Baageer Gaalibaaf, tarkaanfii qajeelcha liqii (interest rate) Ameerikaan fudhattee fi waraana isaan gidduu jiru ilaalchisee miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti qeeqan. Gaalibaaf akka jedhutti, Ameerikaan liqii dabaluun ishee galaana Hormuz kan Iraan cufte irratti dhiibbaa hin qabu, akkasumas Itoophiyaan keessatti akka hubatametti Iraan diinagdee addunyaa irratti harka qabdi. Kunis ibrataa waraana kana keessatti Iraan tarkaanfii diinagdee Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu akka dandeessu agarsiisuuf kan godhame dha.

title: India-Pakistan navy ship collision sparks alarm over unintended escalation
english: A naval collision between Indian and Pakistani warships in the Arabian Sea has caused diplomatic friction between the two nuclear-armed nations. Both countries have exchanged formal protests and blame each other for the incident, which occurred amidst ongoing regional tensions. Experts warn that such maritime encounters carry a significant risk of accidental escalation due to the lack of communication channels between the two militaries.
amharic: በህንድ እና በፓኪስታን የባህር ኃይል መርከቦች መካከል በአረብ ባህር የተፈጠረው ግጭት በሁለቱ የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ ባለቤት ሀገራት መካከል ከፍተኛ የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረት ፈጥሯል። ሁለቱም ወገኖች የየራሳቸውን የውጭ ጉዳይ ዲፕሎማቶች በመጥራት ለግጭቱ ተጠያቂው ሌላኛው ወገን እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ቀጥተኛ የመግባቢያ መስመር መዳከም፣ መሰል ድንገተኛ ክስተቶች ወደ ትልቅ ግጭት ሊያመሩ እንደሚችሉ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gurgurtoonni waraanaa biyyoota Hindii fi Paakistaan gidduutti Galaana Arabiyaa keessatti mudate, biyyoota meeshaa niwukilaraa qaban lamaan gidduutti shakkii fi wal-dhabdee diippilomaasii guddaa uumeera. Biyyoonni lameenuu miidhaa ga'eef kan itti gaafatamuu qabu gama kaanii ta'uu ibsuun, gamaa gamaan komii wal-irratti dhiyeessaniiru. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, wal-qunnamtii waraanaa cimaa ta'e dhabuun, gochaan tasaa kun gara waraana bal'aatti akka hin ceene sodaachisaa jira.

title: How far will Egypt go to help Saudi Arabia secure the Red Sea?
english: Following the seizure of Yemen's Red Sea coast by Houthi rebels, Egypt and Saudi Arabia are strengthening their military and strategic cooperation. Both nations are concerned that instability near the Bab al-Mandeb strait threatens vital shipping traffic, which directly impacts Egypt's Suez Canal revenue and regional security. Analysts suggest that Cairo and Riyadh are forming a united front to deter Iran-backed groups and protect their shared maritime economic interests.

title: Real Madrid fan group demands Mbappe apology for Ceuta shirt snub
english: A Real Madrid supporters' group is demanding an apology from Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Junior, and Ibrahima Konate for failing to properly wear a tribute shirt meant to support the people of Ceuta. The players partially rolled up the shirts, which aimed to show solidarity during a humanitarian crisis involving migrants, sparking criticism from fans and the league president. Mbappe defended his actions, explaining that he intended to honor both the local residents and the migrants who tragically lost their lives during the border crossing.

title: Pakistan ready to implement Mecca pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey, defence minister says
english: Pakistan's Defence Minister has confirmed the country's commitment to a defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey, pledging to protect Saudi holy sites following Houthi attacks. While specific military details were not provided, officials stressed there is no doubt about their obligation to the agreement. Additionally, Pakistan has engaged in diplomatic efforts with Iran to ensure regional tensions do not escalate further.

title: Palestinian prisoner dies in Israeli custody as family seeks answers
english: Moataz Nizam al-Atrash, a 21-year-old Palestinian, has died while being held in an Israeli prison without any clear explanation from authorities regarding his health or the cause of his passing. His family is deeply shocked because he was reportedly healthy prior to his arrest and detention, which had lasted nearly a year under administrative orders. Advocacy groups are now raising alarms about the safety of Palestinian prisoners, noting that his death is part of a rising number of fatalities within the Israeli prison system.

title: Majd al-Krum: Is Israeli settler terrorism expanding across the Green Line?
english: Israeli settlers have recently set up a camp in Majd al-Krum, a town in northern Israel with a predominantly Palestinian population. While initially presented as a temporary grazing site, local residents fear the outpost is becoming a permanent settlement. This event reflects a long-standing historical strategy of using Jewish settlements to influence demographic shifts and solidify territorial control within Israel and the occupied territories.

title: The Error in Tsmido’s Trial and Error
english: Various Ethiopian armed and political groups are forming a loose alliance, known as Tsmido, primarily driven by a shared desire to weaken Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. While these groups are united in their opposition, they lack a common vision for the country's future and remain deeply divided on key issues like territory and sovereignty. Experts warn that this strategy is highly dangerous, as it risks state collapse and internal conflict without a clear plan for what follows the current administration.

english: The Ethiopian #ትሰማ (Let Her Be Heard) campaign is calling for urgent government action to address systemic failures in prosecuting gender-based violence. While supporters emphasize the need for institutional accountability and justice for victims, critics express concern that the movement reflects Western cultural influence. Ultimately, the campaign has sparked a complex national debate about the future of Ethiopian society, gender roles, and the balance between tradition and progress.

title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
english: Mustafa Suleyman, head of Microsoft AI, has cautioned that the rapid development of autonomous AI systems could inadvertently create a new 'silicon species' that rivals humanity. He criticized competitor Anthropic for giving AI human-like traits, arguing that treating software as if it has personal desires makes it difficult to control. Suleyman emphasized that AI lacks true consciousness and urged the industry to implement practical safeguards to ensure these powerful technologies remain under human supervision.
amharic: የማይክሮሶፍት የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ዋና ዳይሬክተር ሙስጠፋ ሱሌይማን፣ ያልተገደበ የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት የሰው ልጅን ሊወዳደር የሚችል አዲስ 'ሲሊኮን የተባለ ዝርያ' ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ተቀናቃኛቸው ኩባንያ አንትሮፒክ AI የሰው ባህሪ እንዲኖረው ማድረጉ ስህተት እንደሆነ እና ይህ አካሄድ ቴክኖሎጂውን ከቁጥጥር ውጪ ሊያደርገው እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል። ሱሌይማን AI የሰው ልጅን ስሜት ወይም ንቃተ ህሊና እንደሌለው በማስታወስ፣ እነዚህን አደገኛ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ስርዓቶች ለመቆጣጠር ተግባራዊ መፍትሄዎች እንደሚያስፈልጉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan AI kan Microsoft, Mustafa Suleyman, guddinni teknolojii AI kan too'annaa hin qabne sanyiin 'silikonii' jedhamu kan ilmaan namaa wajjin dorgomu akka uumamuu danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Innis dhaabbata dorgomaa isaanii Anthropic, AI akka namaatti ilaalanii fi amaloota namaa itti kennuun isaanii dogoggora ta'uu fi tekinolojicha to'achuun akka nama rakkisu ibseera. Suleyman AI akka namaa sammuu, miira ykn fedhii kan hin qabne ta'uu isaa yaadachiisee, teknolojiin kun akka nutti hin garagalletti tarkaanfiiwwan qabatamaa fudhachuu akka qaban dhaameera.

title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
english: South African authorities are investigating the discovery of nine female bodies found near Johannesburg over the past two months. While police have not yet confirmed if the deaths are linked or caused by a single perpetrator, they have assembled a specialized team to resolve the cases. President Cyril Ramaphosa has condemned the killings and promised a thorough investigation to bring those responsible to justice.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ባለስልጣናት ባለፉት ሁለት ወራት ውስጥ በጆሃንስበርግ አቅራቢያ የተገኙ ዘጠኝ ሴቶች አስክሬን ጉዳይ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ፖሊስ ግድያዎቹ እርስ በርስ የተያያዙ መሆናቸውን ወይም በአንድ ወንጀለኛ የተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን እስካሁን ባያረጋግጥም፣ ጉዳዩን ለመመርመር ልዩ ቡድን አቋቁሟል። ፕሬዝዳንት ሲሪል ራማፎሳ ግድያዎቹን አውግዘው፣ ወንጀለኞቹን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ አጠቃላይ ምርመራ እንደሚደረግ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Afrikaa Kibbaa ji'oota lamaan darbanii as naannoo magaalaa Johannesburgitti reeffa dubartoota sagal argamerratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Poolisiin ajjeechaan kun walqabata ta'uu isaa ykn namuma tokkoon raawwatamu isaa hanga ammaa mirkaneessuu baatus, qorannoo kanaaf garee addaa hundeessaniiru. Pirezidaanti Cyril Ramaphosa ajjeechaa kana balaaleffatanii, yakka kana raawwatan seeratti dhiyeessuuf qorannoo cimaa akka godhan waadaa galaniiru.

title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
english: The European Union has unveiled the 'EU Kids Act,' a legislative proposal aimed at significantly restricting social media access for children under 15 to improve their digital safety and wellbeing. Under this plan, children under 13 would be completely banned from platforms, while those aged 13 to 15 would be limited to one hour of daily use through restricted accounts managed by their parents. Technology companies failing to implement rigorous safety standards would face substantial financial penalties, reaching up to 6% of their global revenue.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት እድሜያቸው ከ15 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናት የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አጠቃቀምን የሚገድብ አዲስ ህግ አስተዋውቋል። በዚህ ዕቅድ መሰረት ከ13 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናት የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መጠቀማቸው ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚከለከል ሲሆን፣ ከ13 እስከ 15 ዓመት ያሉ ህጻናት ደግሞ በወላጆቻቸው ቁጥጥር ስር በቀን ለአንድ ሰዓት ብቻ እንዲጠቀሙ ይደረጋል። ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ መድረክ ማቅረብ ያልቻሉ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ከዓለም አቀፍ ገቢያቸው እስከ 6 በመቶ የሚደርስ ቅጣት ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa ijoolleen waggaa 15 gadi ta'an miidiyaalee hawaasummaa akka hin fayyadamne dhorkuuf seera haaraa baaseera. Karoora kanaan, ijoolleen waggaa 13 gadi ta'an fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye kan dhorkamu yoo ta'u, ijoolleen waggaa 13 hanga 15 jiran ammoo maatiin isaanii akka isaan to'atanitti guyyaatti sa'aatii tokko qofa fayyadamuu danda'u. Dhaabbileen teeknoolojii nageenya ijoollee eeguuf qajeelfama ba'e hin hordofne, galii isaanii kan addunyaa irraa hanga dhibbeentaa 6 adabamuuf jiru.

title: At least 19 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine
english: Russian forces conducted widespread missile and drone strikes across several Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv, Odesa, and Zaporizhzhia, resulting in at least 19 injuries. While Ukrainian air defenses neutralized over 130 aerial targets, falling debris and direct hits damaged numerous homes, schools, and essential infrastructure. Both military and civilian areas were impacted, with emergency services currently working to manage the destruction in the affected districts.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ፣ በኦዴሳ እና በዛፖሪዝሂያ ክልሎች ባደረሱት የሮኬት እና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 19 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የዩክሬን የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት ከ130 በላይ የሆኑ የጠላት ኢላማዎችን ማክሸፍ ቢችልም፣ የወደቁ የጥቃት ቁርጥራጮች እና ቀጥተኛ ጥቃቶች በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና መሰረተ ልማቶችን አውድመዋል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው አካባቢዎች ወታደራዊ እና ሲቪል መገልገያዎችን የሚያካትቱ ሲሆን፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የደረሰውን ጉዳት ለመቆጣጠር ስራቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa naannoolee Yukreen kan akka Kiyiv, Odesa fi Zapoorizhiyaa irratti weerara rokkeetii fi drooniin geggeessaniin namoonni 19 ol miidhamaniiru. Humnoonni ittisa qilleensaa Yukreen miilaa fi droonii 130 ol ta'an fashalsuu danda'anis, kutaaleen weerarichaa bu'uuraalee misoomaa, manneen jireenyaa fi manneen barnootaa irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Miidhaan kun iddoowwan waraanaa fi kan namoota nagaa irratti kan qaqqabe yoo ta'u, tajaajilli ariifachiisaan miidhaa qaqqabe to'achuuf qophii irra jira.

title: Beckham backs Messi for Ballon d’Or after netting 100th Inter Miami goal
english: David Beckham has publicly supported Lionel Messi to win a record ninth Ballon d'Or following his impressive performance in the Campeones Cup. Messi recently reached a milestone of 100 goals for Inter Miami after helping the team secure a 2-0 victory against Cruz Azul. Beckham praised the 39-year-old for maintaining such a high level of play at his age, noting that his consistent excellence makes him the most deserving candidate for the prestigious award.
amharic: ዴቪድ ቤካም ሊዮኔል ሜሲ በካምፔዮንስ ዋንጫ ላይ ባሳየው ድንቅ ብቃት ዘጠነኛውን የባሎንዶር ሽልማት እንዲያሸንፍ ድጋፉን ሰጥቷል። ሜሲ ኢንተር ማያሚ ክሩዝ አዙልን 2 ለ 0 ባሸነፈበት ጨዋታ 100ኛ ግቡን አስመዝግቧል። ቤካም በ39 ዓመቱ ሜሲ እያሳየ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ያለው ብቃት በማድነቅ ለዚህ ታላቅ ሽልማት ተገቢው ሰው መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Deevid Beekhaam taphataan isaa Liyooneel Meesiin badhaasa 'Ballon d'Or' saglaffaa isaa akka argatuuf deggarsa isaa ibseera. Meesiin tapha 'Campeones Cup' irratti goolii 100ffaa isaa galchuun gareen Inter Miami tapha Kuruuz Aazuul irratti 2-0 akka mo'atu gargaareera. Beekhaam gootichi kun umrii isaa waggaa 39 keessatti sadarkaa olaanaarratti taphachuu isaa dinqisiifachuun, badhaasichaaf inni nama filatamaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: ‘They called us’: Has Trump abandoned Bab al-Mandeb to the Houthis?
english: President Donald Trump has indicated that the United States will not intervene as Houthi forces secure strategic control over the Bab al-Mandeb strait. Despite the Houthis threatening Saudi maritime trade, Trump claimed the group sought to avoid conflict with the U.S. and is allowing most international traffic to pass. This signals a significant shift in American policy, potentially ending the long-standing security arrangements between the U.S. and Gulf nations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የባብ አል-ማንዴብ የባህር መስመርን መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ አሜሪካ ጣልቃ እንደማትገባ አስታውቀዋል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳዑዲ አረቢያን የንግድ መርከቦች የሚያሰፈራሩ ቢሆንም፣ ከዋሽንግተን ጋር ግጭት እንደማይፈልጉና ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን እንደማያስተጓጉሉ ትራምፕ ገልጸዋል። ይህ አካሄድ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን የጸጥታና የነዳጅ ስምምነት የሚያበቃ ትልቅ የፖሊሲ ለውጥን ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp humnoonni Huutii daandii galaana Baab al-Maandeb to’achuu isaanii hordofee, Ameerikaan gidduu akka hin galle ibsaniiru. Humnoonni Huutii daldala galaana Sa’udii Arabiyaa irratti doorsisa uumaa jiranis, gareen kun Waashingitan waliin walitti bu’iinsa barbaaduu akka hin qabnee fi daandii galaanichaa gadi lakkisaa akka jiran Tiraamp dubbataniiru. Adeemsi kun hariiroo nageenyaa fi boba’aa waggoota hedduuf Ameerikaa fi biyyoota Gilaafii gidduu ture kan xumuru, jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa ta’uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: From Yanbu to Sohar: Tracking Saudi Arabia’s alternative oil routes
english: Saudi Arabia is struggling to maintain oil exports after drone attacks disabled a critical pipeline and the Strait of Hormuz remains closed due to regional conflict. To bypass these disruptions, the country is increasingly relying on secretive ship-to-ship transfers off the coast of Oman. These logistics challenges have caused a significant decline in total oil shipments, threatening global energy supplies.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር በድሮን ጥቃት ጉዳት በመድረሱ እና የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በግጭት ምክንያት በመዘጋቱ ሀገሪቱ የነዳጅ ኤክስፖርቷን ለማስቀጠል ትልቅ ፈተና ገጥሟታል። ይህንን ችግር ለመቅረፍ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ በሚደረጉ ሚስጥራዊ የነዳጅ ዝውውሮች ላይ እየተመካች ትገኛለች። እነዚህ የሎጂስቲክስ መሰናክሎች የነዳጅ ምርት ሽያጭ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ላይም ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Saudi Arabiyaan miidhaa buufata bittaa fi gurgurtaa boba'aa irratti dhufeen akkasumas dhiphina galaana Hormuz kan walitti bu'iinsa naannichaan cufamee jiruun, gabaa boba'aa addunyaa irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa galteetti. Rakkoo kana hiikuuf, biyyattiin boba'aa ishee doonii irraa gara dooniitti seeraan ala fi dhoksaan dabarsuudhaan gara Omaanitti erguuf yaalaa jirti. Rakkoon kun gabaa boba'aa addunyaa irratti dhiyeessii gadi buusuun isaa yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Pernicious states: Towards a new grammar of international relations
english: The article argues that powerful nations often manipulate language and international concepts to justify their global actions and hide systemic violence. It proposes the term 'pernicious state' to describe countries whose very structure is designed to cause ongoing international harm and imperial domination. By reframing how we discuss global politics, the author aims to challenge the biased terminology currently used to favor Western interests.
amharic: ጽሁፉ እንደሚያብራራው ሀያላን ሀገራት የዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦችን እና ቋንቋዎችን በመቆጣጠር ድርጊታቸውን እንደሚያመላክቱ ይገልጻል። ደራሲው አወቃቀራቸው በራሱ ለሌሎች ጉዳት በሚያደርስ መልኩ የተገነቡ ሀገራትን ለመግለጽ 'ጎጂ ሀገር' (pernicious state) የሚል አዲስ ቃል ያቀርባል። ይህ አቀራረብ በምዕራባውያን የሚመራው የዓለም አቀፍ የፖለቲካ አመለካከት በሌሎች ላይ የሚያደርሰውን ተጽዕኖ ለመቃወም ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Barruun kun biyyoonni cimaan adeemsa siyaasaa fi jechoota addunyaa to'achuun gocha isaanii akkaataa ittiin dhoksan ibsa. Barreessaan kun biyyoota caasaa isaanii irraa kaasee miidhaa geessisuu irratti xiyyeeffatan ibsuuf 'biyyoota miidhaa geessisan' (pernicious state) kan jedhu yaada haaraa dhiyeesseera. Yaanni kun akkaataa addunyaan siyaasaa irratti ibsamu jijjiiruun, dhiibbaa biyyoonni lixaa qaban balaaleffachuuf gargaara.

title: Europe's most powerful party is stoking a Muslim scare
english: The European People's Party (EPP), the largest political group in Europe, recently passed a resolution that frames Muslim civic participation and religious practices as potential threats to democratic processes. Led by figures like Ursula von der Leyen, the party adopts a restrictive approach that mirrors controversial German policies regarding 'political Islam.' Critics argue this shift targets Muslim organizations and individuals by treating them with suspicion and undermining their rights to participate in civil society.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ትልቁ የፖለቲካ ቡድን የሆነው የአውሮፓ ህዝቦች ፓርቲ (EPP)፣ የሙስሊሞችን ማህበራዊ ተሳትፎ እና ሃይማኖታዊ ልምምዶች ለዲሞክራሲ ስጋት አድርጎ የሚመለከት ውሳኔ አሳልፏል። ይህ በኡርሱላ ፎን ደር ላይን የሚመራው ፓርቲ፣ በጀርመን የሚታየውን 'ፖለቲካዊ እስልምና' ላይ ያተኮረ አወዛጋቢ አካሄድ መከተሉን ያሳያል። ተቺዎች ይህ አካሄድ የሙስሊም ድርጅቶችን እና ግለሰቦችን በጥርጣሬ በመመልከት በፍትሐ ብሔር ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ ያላቸውን ተሳትፎ የሚያዳክም እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Paartiin Namoota Awurooppaa (EPP) jedhamu, garee siyaasaa Awurooppaa keessatti guddaa ta'e, hirmaannaa hawaasummaa fi gocha amantii Muslimootaa akka sodaatti kan ilaalu murtee dabarseera. Paartiin kun, kan dursamu Ursula von der Leyen tiin, mala biyya Jarman keessatti 'Isilaamummaa siyaasaa' irratti qaban kan itti fayyadamuu fi shakkii keessa galchuudha. Namoonni qaana'an akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbilee Muslimootaa fi namoota dhuunfaa shakkiin ilaaluun hirmaannaa isaanii kan daangessu dha.

title: Netanyahu calls to strip citizenship of those who 'defame' Israeli army
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to introduce legislation that would revoke the citizenship of individuals who publicly criticize or defame Israeli soldiers. The proposed bills also include significantly higher financial penalties for those sued for defamation against the military. This move follows the release of a documentary featuring soldiers who claimed war crimes were committed in Gaza.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤልን ወታደሮች የሚተቹ ወይም የሚያጠለሹ ሰዎች ዜግነታቸው እንዲሰረዝ የሚያስችል ህግ ለማውጣት አቅደዋል። የቀረበው ረቂቅ ህግ በወታደራዊው ላይ ስም ማጥፋት ለሚከሰሱ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት መጣልን ያካትታል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በጋዛ ውስጥ የጦር ወንጀል መፈጸማቸውን የሚናገሩ ወታደሮችን ያሳየ ዘጋቢ ፊልም ከተለቀቀ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu namoota loltoota Israa'el arrabsan ykn maqaa balleessan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf seera baasuuf karoorfateera. Seerichi namoota akkasii irratti himata maqaa balleessii dhiyeessuun adabbii maallaqaa cimaa kaffalchiisuu fi ዜgnummaa isaanii irraa mulquu kan dabalatuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga sagantaan suura-sagaleedhaan qophaa'e tokko waraana Gaaza keessatti raawwatame jedhame ilaalchisee loltoonni ragaa ba'anii booda.

title: Palestinians hospitalised after beating by Israeli soldiers in Nablus
english: Two Palestinian men, aged 60 and 31, were hospitalized after being assaulted by Israeli military forces. The incident occurred while the soldiers were conducting a raid and questioning residents at the Al-Ain refugee camp near Nablus. Medical officials confirmed the injuries sustained by the victims during their detention.
amharic: በናብሉስ በሚገኘው የአል-አይን የስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፕ እስራኤል ባደረገችው ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን በወታደሮች ድብደባ ደርሶባቸው ሆስፒታል ገብተዋል። በድብደባው የተጎዱት የ60 እና የ31 ዓመት ግለሰቦች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው በነበረበት ወቅት እንደነበር ተነግሯል። የህክምና ምንጮች ሁለቱም ግለሰቦች ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Naablusitti buufata baqattootaa Al-Ain keessatti waraanni Israa'el duula gaggeesseen namoonni Falasxiin lama miidhamanii hospitaala galan. Namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e kun kan umuriin isaanii 60 fi 31 ta'an yoo ta'u, erga qabamanii booda waraanaan reebamaniiru. Maddoonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, namoonni kun yeroo qorannaa jala turanitti miidhaan akka irra ga'e mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Netanyahu calls to strip citizenship of those who 'defame' Israeli army
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plans to introduce legislation that would revoke the citizenship of anyone who defames the Israeli military. This move follows the release of a documentary titled NAZA, which includes testimony from soldiers regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza. Government officials have criticized the filmmakers for treason and are seeking harsh legal and financial penalties against them.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤልን ጦር ያጠለሹ ሰዎችን ዜግነት የሚገፍ ህግ እንደሚያወጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በጋዛ የተፈጸሙ የጦር ወንጀሎችን የሚያጋልጠው 'ናዛ' የተሰኘ ዘጋቢ ፊልም መለቀቅን ተከትሎ ነው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት የፊልሙን አዘጋጆች በአገር ክህደት በመክሰስ ከዜግነት እንዲሰረዙ እና ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት እንዲጣልባቸው እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahuu namoota waraana Israa'el arrabsan ykn maqaa xureessan irraa lammii biyyattii mulquuf seera akka baasu beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe dookumentarii 'NAZA' jedhamu kan waraana Gaaza keessatti raawwatame jedhamee shakkamu qabatu erga gadhiifamee booda. Qondaaltonni mootummaa qopheessitoota fiilmii kana 'gantoota' jechuun himatanii, lammiin irraa akka mulqamuufi adabbii maallaqaa cimaanis akka irratti murteeffamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Saudi-led coalition air strikes kill one in Yemen's Hajjah province
english: Airstrikes conducted by a Saudi-led coalition in Yemen's Hajjah province resulted in the death of one person. The attack, which involved two separate strikes in the city of Avs, also left another individual injured. Additionally, the strikes caused significant damage to a residential home and destroyed four vehicles.
amharic: በየመን ሀጃህ ግዛት በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት ባደረሰው የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል። በአቭስ ከተማ በተፈጸሙ ሁለት የአየር ጥቃቶች ሌላ አንድ ሰው የቆሰለ ሲሆን በአራት ተሽከርካሪዎች እና በአንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል።
oromo: Godina Hajjaah kan Yamanitti haleellaa xiyyaaraa kutaalee waraana Sa'udii gaggeessaniin namni tokko lubbuun darbeera. Magaalaa Avs keessatti haleellaa lama gaggeeffameen namni biraan tokko madaa'eera; akkasumas konkolaattoonni afur fi mana jireenya tokko manca'aniiru.

title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
english: A recent BBC investigation has revealed that the 2012 abduction of American journalist Austin Tice in Syria was a pre-planned government operation rather than an accidental encounter. Evidence suggests the kidnapping was authorized by Bashar al-Assad's regime and organized over several weeks. Despite extensive searches and the collapse of the Syrian government, Tice’s exact fate remains unknown.
amharic: የቢቢሲ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው በ2012 በአሜሪካዊው ጋዜጠኛ ኦስቲን ታይስ ላይ በሶሪያ የተፈፀመው ታፍኖ መወሰድ በአጋጣሚ ሳይሆን በመንግስት አስቀድሞ የታቀደ ነበር። ማስረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት ይህ ድርጊት በባሽር አል-አሳድ አስተዳደር የተፈቀደ እና ከአንድ ወር በላይ ዝግጅት የተደረገበት ነው። ሰፊ ፍለጋዎች ቢደረጉም እና የሶሪያ መንግስት ቢወድቅም የጋዜጠኛው የት መድረስ እስካሁን በውል አልታወቀም።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC dhihoo kana gaggeesse akka ibsetti, bara 2012tti gaazexeessaan Ameerikaa Austin Tice mootummaa Sooriyaatiin gudeedamee butamuun isaa osoo hin taane, karoorfamee kan raawwatame dha. Ragaan akka mul'isutti, butuun kun ajaja Bashar al-Assadtiin kan hayyamamee fi torbanoota hedduuf kan qopha'ame dha. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoo bal'aa fi kufaatii mootummaa Sooriyaa boodas, haalli gaazexeessichaa amma ammaatti hin beekamu.

title: Rosenberg: Russia's elections will have few surprises, but for the Kremlin they matter
english: Russia's upcoming parliamentary election is expected to produce predictable results, keeping Vladimir Putin's allies in firm control of the government. Despite claims from critics that the process lacks fairness, the Kremlin views this vote as a vital opportunity to showcase public support for the ongoing war in Ukraine. Additionally, the government is using the election to boost the political standing of military veterans who have returned from the front lines.
amharic: የሩሲያ መጪው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ምንም አይነት ያልተጠበቀ ለውጥ እንደማያመጣ እና የቭላዲሚር ፑቲን ደጋፊዎች በስልጣን እንደሚቆዩ ይጠበቃል። ምርጫው ነጻ እና ፍትሃዊ አይደለም የሚሉ ወቀሳዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ክሬምሊን በዩክሬን ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት ህዝባዊ ድጋፍ እንዳለው ለማሳየት ይህን አጋጣሚ እየተጠቀመበት ነው። በተጨማሪም መንግስት ከጦርነቱ የተመለሱ የቀድሞ ወታደሮችን የፖለቲካ ተሳትፎ ለማሳደግ ምርጫውን እንደ መሳሪያ እየተጠቀመበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Filannoon paarlaamaa biyya Rashiyaa dhufu kun jijjiirama hin eegamne tokko iyyuu kan hin fiduufi hoggantoonni Vladimir Puutin aangoo irratti akka turan kan taasisu ta'uu ibsameera. Filannichi bilisaafi haqa qabeessa miti kan jedhu mormii jiruus, mootummaan Raashiyaa filannicha waraana Yukreeniif deggersa qabaachuu isaanii ibsuuf itti fayyadamaa jira. Kana malees, mootummaan filannicha waraana duraanii irraa deebi'an bakka bu'oota siyaasaa taasisuuf akka carraatti itti gargaaramaa jira.

title: Argentinian judge orders suspension of Falklands oil project
english: An Argentinian judge has issued a symbolic order to pause a British-Israeli oil exploration project near the Falkland Islands. This legal action was prompted by war veterans and environmentalists who argue the project lacks proper environmental oversight. The ruling intensifies Argentina's ongoing territorial dispute with the United Kingdom over the islands.
amharic: የአርጀንቲና ዳኛ በፎክላንድ ደሴቶች አቅራቢያ የሚካሄድ የብሪታንያ እና እስራኤል የነዳጅ ፍለጋ ፕሮጀክት እንዲታገድ ትእዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የቀረበው በጦርነት አርበኞች እና በአካባቢ ጥበቃ ጠበቆች ጥያቄ መሠረት ፕሮጀክቱ በቂ የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ግምገማ እንደሌለው በመግለጽ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አርጀንቲና በደሴቶቹ ላይ ያላትን የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ለማጠናከር የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Arjentiinaa tokko pirojektii qorannoo boba'aa kan biyyoota Biriiteenii fi Israa'el ganda Falkland jedhamu biratti gaggeeffamaa jiru akka dhaabbatu ajajaniiru. Ajajni kun kan kenname, injiinaroonni waraanaa fi ogeeyyonni eegumsa naannoo pirojektichi qorannoo eegumsa naannoo sirrii ta'e hin qabu jedhanii himachuu isaaniitiin. Tarkaanfiin kun Arjentiinaan naannicha irratti mirga abbummaa ishee mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtu keessaa tokko dha.

title: Trump threatens to end trade with Mexico and Europe after rate hike
english: President Trump has threatened to halt trade with Mexico, Canada, and the European Union following the Federal Reserve's decision to increase interest rates. Although the President had urged officials to keep rates lower, the Fed chose to raise them unanimously. Consequently, Trump is now targeting nations with which the United States holds a trade deficit as a form of retaliation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ የወለድ ምጣኔን ከፍ ለማድረግ በወሰነው ውሳኔ በመበሳጨት ከሜክሲኮ፣ ከካናዳ እና ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የሚደረገውን ንግድ እንደሚያቆሙ አስፈራርተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንቱ የወለድ ምጣኔው ዝቅተኛ ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል ቢጠይቁም፣ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ በአንድ ድምፅ የወለድ ጭማሪውን አጽድቋል። በዚህም ምክንያት አሜሪካ ከእነዚህ አገራት ጋር ያላትን የንግድ ጉድለት መሰረት በማድረግ ትራምፕ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pireezidanti Traamp, baankiin giddu galeessa Ameerikaa (Federal Reserve) qondaaltotaan dhiibbaa godhanii osoo jiranii dhala liqii dabaluuf murteessuu isaa hordofee, biyyoota akka Meeksiikoo, Kanaadaa fi Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin daldala dhaabuuf sodaachisaniiru. Pireezidantichi dhalli liqii akka hin daballe yaalii godhanii turanillee, baankiin sun sagalee guutuun dabaluuf murteesseera. Kanaafuu, Traamp biyyoota Ameerikaan daldala irratti hir'ina qabdu waliin jiran irratti tarkaanfii akkasii fudhachuuf akka karoorsan beekameera.

title: Can AI regulation keep America ahead of China?
english: The United States is currently evaluating how to implement artificial intelligence regulations without hindering its competitive edge against China. Experts argue that establishing proper governance does not necessarily mean stopping progress. The goal is to create a regulatory framework that manages potential risks while simultaneously fostering an environment where innovation can flourish.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከቻይና ጋር ያለውን የቴክኖሎጂ ፉክክር ሳይጎዳ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) እንዴት መቆጣጠር እንደሚቻል እየመከረ ነው። የዘርፉ ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ተገቢ የሆነ ህግ ማውጣት የቴክኖሎጂ እድገትን አያግድም። ዋናው ዓላማ አደገኛ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ሁኔታዎችን መቆጣጠርና በዚሁ ጊዜ የፈጠራ ስራዎችን ማበረታታት ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa teknooloojii 'AI' jedhamu kana sadarkaa biyyaattis ta'e guutuu addunyaatti dorgomaa ta'ee itti fufuuf mala akkamii akka hordoftu mari'achaa jirti. Hayyoonni damichaa akka jedhanitti, seera baasuun of eeggannoo gochuuf malee, guddina teknooloojichaa daangessuu miti. Kaayyoon guddaan balaa isaa to'achaa, carraa gara fuulduraatti innooveeshinii uumuuf gargaaruu dha.

title: US bars Palestinian president from attending UNGA for second year
english: For the second consecutive year, the United States has refused to issue entry visas to Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas and other Palestinian Authority officials. This decision prevents them from traveling to New York to participate in the annual United Nations General Assembly. No specific reason was provided for this move, which continues a trend of restricted diplomatic access for Palestinian leadership.
amharic: አሜሪካ የፍልስጤሙ ፕሬዝዳንት ማህሙድ አባስ እና ሌሎች የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት በኒውዮርክ ለሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ እንዳይገኙ ለሁለተኛ ተከታታይ አመት ቪዛ ከልክላለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የፍልስጤም መሪዎች በስብሰባው ላይ እንዳይሳተፉ አግዷቸዋል። የባይደን አስተዳደር ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰደበትን ምክንያት በግልጽ አልገለጸም።
oromo: Ameerikaan, Pirezedaantii Philaasxeemii Mahmuud Abbaas fi hoogganoota aangoo Philaasxeemii biroo, walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kan Niyuuyorkitti adeemsifamu irratti akka hin hirmaanneef waggaa lammaffaadhaaf hayyama seenu (visa) dhorkatteerti. Murtoon kun hoogganoonni Philaasxeemii walga'icharratti akka hin argamne taasiseera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa sababa dhorkaa kanaa ifatti hin ibsine.

title: US extends visa ban on Palestinian officials before UN General Assembly
english: The United States has renewed a visa ban on Palestinian Authority and PLO officials, once again preventing President Mahmoud Abbas from traveling to New York for the United Nations General Assembly. The State Department claims this action is due to the Palestinian leadership's failure to implement reforms and their efforts to seek statehood recognition through international courts. While the Palestinian mission to the UN can still operate, key leaders remain barred from entry, marking the second consecutive year of these restrictions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር እና የፍልስጤም ነጻ አውጪ ድርጅት (PLO) ባለስልጣናት ላይ የጣለውን የቪዛ ክልከላ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ አራዝሟል። በዚህ ውሳኔ መሰረት የፍልስጤሙ ፕሬዝዳንት ማህሙድ አባስ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ስብሰባ ወደ ኒውዮርክ መጓዝ አይችሉም። አሜሪካ ይህንን የወሰደችው የፍልስጤም አመራር አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ለውጦችን ባለማድረጉ እና የፍልስጤምን ነጻነት በአለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤቶች ለመጠየቅ በመሞከሩ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hayyoota aangoo Paalastayinii fi jaarmiyaa PLO irratti dhorkaa viizaa erge ture lammata dheeressuun isaa beekameera. Murtii kanaan walqabatee Preezdaantiin Paalastayinii Mahmuud Abbaas gumiin waliigalaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti hirmaachuuf gara Niiw Yoorkii imaluu akka hin dandeenye ta'eera. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, hoggantoonni Paalastayinii jijjiirama barbaadamu gochuu fi mootummaa ofii isaanii beekamtii argachuuf karaa mana murtii addunyaa deemuu isaaniitiin walqabatee akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: 'Few cards to play': Saudi Arabia faces limited options against Houthis with allies out
english: Saudi Arabia is struggling to counter increasing attacks from Houthi forces as it lacks strong international support. The Kingdom's oil infrastructure has been damaged by drones and missiles, and even sensitive religious sites like Mecca have been threatened. With the disabling of a key pipeline and constant aerial strikes, the Saudi government currently faces very few strategic options to defend its territory.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከአጋሮቿ ድጋፍ በማጣቷ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚሰነዘሩባትን ጥቃቶች ለመከላከል ተቸግራለች። በሳውዲ ዘይት ማስተላለፊያ መስመሮች ላይ በድሮንና በሚሳኤል የሚደርሰው ጉዳት ሀገሪቱን ለከፍተኛ ፈተና ዳርጓታል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተቀደሰችውን መካ ከተማን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ የሳውዲ አካባቢዎች ጥቃት እየሰነዘሩ በመሆኑ፣ የሳውዲ መንግስት ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ውስን አማራጮች ብቻ ቀርተውታል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan deeggarsa alaa dhabuu ishee irraa kan ka'e haleellaa garee Huutii ittisuun itti ulfaatee jira. Miidhaan bu'uraalee misoomaa boba'aa irratti qaqqabaa jiru fi haleellaan magaalota qulqulluu akka Makkaatti xiyyeeffachuu isaa gabaafameera. Haala kanaan, mootummaan Saudii qooda fudhannaa kanaan duraa dhabuun isaa, of ittisuuf filannoo muraasa qofa akka qabaatu isa godheera.

title: South Korea foreign minister says no decision made on Hormuz Strait military deployment
english: South Korea's foreign minister stated that the government has not yet decided whether to send military forces to the Strait of Hormuz. Officials are currently evaluating the situation, focusing on protecting their citizens and ensuring safe passage for ships. The country remains caught between pressure from the United States to join the mission and warnings from Iran regarding the potential consequences of such a move.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ወደ ሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ስለመላክ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ውሳኔ እንዳልተላለፈ ገለጹ። መንግስት የዜጎቹን ደህንነት እና የባህር መተላለፊያውን ነፃነት ከግምት ውስጥ በማስገባት ሁኔታውን እየገመገመ ነው። አገሪቱ በአንድ በኩል ከአሜሪካ የሚደርስባት ግፊት፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ከኢራን የሚሰነዘርባትን ማስጠንቀቂያ ከግምት በማስገባት ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት ውሳኔ ለመስጠት እየሞከረች ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa akka jedhutti, gara dhangala'aa galaana Hormuzitti waraana ergachuu ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti murtoon tokko hin irra ga'amne. Mootummaan fedhii lammiilee isaa fi nageenya karaa galaanichaa eeguuf jecha haalicha qorachaa jira. Biyyattiin dhiibbaa Ameerikaan irra geessisaa jirtuu fi akeekkachiisa Iraan irraa dhufe gidduutti murtoo of eeggannoo qabu gochuuf karoorfachaa jirti.

title: Will the UAE split from the rest of the GCC?
english: Experts are examining how the ongoing conflict involving Iran is influencing the foreign policies of Gulf nations. Analysts suggest that countries in the region may adopt a balanced strategy by simultaneously distancing themselves from the United States and limiting their ties with Iran. This potential shift could significantly alter political alignments across the Middle East.
amharic: ባለሙያዎች በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት የውጭ ግንኙነት ፖሊሲ ላይ ምን ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ እንዳለ እየገመገሙ ነው። የክልሉ አገራት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት በማላላት እና በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ከኢራን ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት በመገደብ ሚዛናዊ የሆነ አካሄድ ሊከተሉ እንደሚችሉ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ሊከሰት የሚችል የፖሊሲ ለውጥ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለውን የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ በእጅጉ ሊቀይረው ይችላል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin walqabatu biyyoota Gulf irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka geessisu qorachaa jiru. Biyyoonni naannichaa gama tokkoon Amerikaa irraa fagaachuufi gama biraatiin ammoo Iraan waliin walitti dhufeenya isaanii daangessuudhaan tarkaanfii madaalawaa fudhachuu akka danda'an yaadama. jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun naannoo Baha Giddugaleessaa keessatti hidhata siyaasaa gara fuulduraa jijjiiruu danda'a.

title: Israeli attacks reported across south Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces conducted a series of airstrikes and shelling operations across multiple locations in southern Lebanon throughout the night and into Thursday morning. These attacks targeted several towns, including al-Mansouri, al-Qantara, and Kfar Tebnit, causing significant explosions. The ongoing military activity has impacted various areas, creating widespread concern in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ አካባቢዎች ላይ ማክሰኞ ምሽት እና ሐሙስ ጠዋት የአየር ድብደባዎችን እና የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ ከፍተዋል። ድብደባው አል-ማንሱሪን፣ አል-ቃንታራን እና ከፍር ተብኒትን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ከተሞች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎችን አስከትሏል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በክልሉ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'eel halkan guutuu fi guyyaa Kamisaa ganama kutaa kibba Libaanoositti bakkeewwan hedduu irratti haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa gurguddaan haleelaniiru. Haleellaan kun magaalota akka Al-Mansuurii, Al-Qantaraa fi Kfaar Tebniit fa'i kanneen irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, dhoochaa cimaa uumeera. Gochi waraanaa kun naannichatti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Hormus Strait traffic drops to three vessels on Wednesday
english: Ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz saw a significant decline on Wednesday, with only three commodity vessels recorded. This figure is a sharp drop from the 12 ships observed the previous day and remains far below the usual average of 17. Experts noted that these tracking statistics might be incomplete, as some ships often disable their tracking devices to remain undetected.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚያልፉ የሸቀጥ መርከቦች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሶ ሶስት ብቻ ሆኗል። ይህ ቁጥር ከአንድ ቀን በፊት ከነበሩት 12 መርከቦች ጋር ሲነፃፀር ከፍተኛ ቅናሽ ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ከመደበኛው የ17 መርከቦች አማካይ በታች ነው። መረጃው የተሰበሰበው የመርከብ መከታተያ ቴክኖሎጂን በመጠቀም ቢሆንም፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች እንዳይታወቁ የራዳር መከታተያዎቻቸውን ሊያጠፉ ስለሚችሉ ትክክለኛው ቁጥር ሊለያይ ይችላል።
oromo: Guyyaa Roobii darbe keessa dooniiwwan gurguddoon daldalaa qarqara Hormuz irra deemanii dabran baay'inaan sadii qofa ta'aniiru. Lakkoofsi kun guyyaa tokko dura dooniiwwan 12 turan irraa kan hir'ate yoo ta'u, giddu-galeessa guyyoota kurnan darban keessa turan 17 irraas baay'ee gadi bu'eera. Gabaasni kun hordoffii dooniiwwanirratti kan hundaa'e ta'us, dooniiwwan tokko tokko hordoffii irraa of dhoksuuf qaxxaamuraasaanii ykn 'transponder' isaanii waan cufataniif, lakkoofsi sirrii ta'e garagara ta'uu danda'a.

title: NHL superstar Ovechkin ‘was asked’ to film Putin ad, team says
english: The Washington Capitals organization stated that NHL star Alex Ovechkin was requested by his home country to appear in a campaign video for Vladimir Putin’s political party. Ovechkin, who has a history of supporting the Russian president, featured in the promotional clip ahead of the nation's upcoming parliamentary elections. While the hockey team is focusing on the athlete’s upcoming season, the move has faced backlash due to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
amharic: የዋሽንግተን ካፒታልስ ቡድን የኤንኤችኤል ኮከብ አሌክስ ኦቬችኪን በፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ የማስተዋወቂያ ቪዲዮ ላይ እንዲታይ በአገሩ እንደተጠየቀ አስታውቋል። ቀደም ሲልም የፑቲን ደጋፊ በመባል የሚታወቀው ኦቬችኪን፣ በሩሲያ በተካሄደው ምርጫ ወቅት ለገዢው ፓርቲ ድጋፍ የሚሰጥ ቪዲዮ ላይ ታይቷል። ምንም እንኳን የቡድኑ አስተዳደር ትኩረታቸውን በስፖርታዊ ውድድሮች ላይ ለማድረግ ቢሞክሩም፣ ድርጊቱ በዩክሬን እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት አንጻር ከፍተኛ ትችቶችን አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Garee Waashingitan Kaapitaals akka ibsetti, taphataan beekamaa NHL Aleks Ovechkiin viidiyoo duula filannoo paartii Vladimir Puutiin irratti akka hirmaatu biyyasaa irraa gaafatamuu ibseera. Ovechkiin yeroo dheeraaf pirezidaanticha deggeraa kan ture yoo ta'u, filannoo biyyoolessaa biyyattii dursee viidiyoo paartii sanaa irratti mul'ateera. Gareen isaa xiyyeeffannoo isaa gara tapha kubbaa qoraa kanarratti taasisuuf yaaluus, hirmaannaan kun waraana Yukreen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee mormii cimaa kaasuu danda'eera.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US nearing end of war, claims Tehran direct talks
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the United States is approaching the conclusion of its conflict with Iran and claims to be engaged in direct communication with the Iranian government. Meanwhile, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres is calling for a reduction in tensions as violence escalates in the broader Middle East, particularly involving Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces in Yemen.
